body:
emily.chen: Running into a POC blocker: streaming + tool_call returns broken JSON to customer. Details below.
tom.adams: Who's the customer and which model/endpoint?
emily.chen: VertiBank, using hosted /v1/chat.completions with redwood-xy-2-large. They call `risk_tool` and expect a single JSON object. Works with stream=false, fails with stream=true.
lee_platform: Paste sanitized stream chunks please.
emily.chen: Sanitized stream: [chunk] {"role":"tool","name":"risk_tool","content":"{\"risk\":\"low\"}"} [chunk] {"role":"assistant","content":"\nNote: risk ok, returning result"} [chunk] {"role":"assistant","content":"\n{\"verdict\":{\"score\":0.03}}"} [end]

security-bot: Customer also sent a security questionnaire; they want encryption in transit + KMS details.
tom.adams: Customer error shows JSONDecodeError: Extra data. They need streaming for latency. Any short-term mitigation?
lee_platform: Mitigations: 1) ask customer to disable streaming (not ideal), 2) use system prompt to require STRICT_JSON output (\"Please return exactly one JSON object, no commentary, no code fences\"), 3) SDK assemble only assistant content after tool_end and strip fences before parsing.
deploy-bot: Eng PR queued to add stream framing tokens and a runtime flag strict_json_stream=true. CI in progress.
emily.chen: Sales asks: 1) can we provide Dedicated eval pricing estimate today (3x A100 equiv)? 2) ETA for runtime fix? 3) Can security prep a QSA reply template?
tom.adams: Quick answers: Estimate ~$30k/month list for 3x A100 equiv; we can offer a short trial discount subject to finance. Eng ETA: internal canary in ~48-72 hours, GA in ~7-10 business days if CI passes. Security will prepare draft answers.
lee_platform: Short-term SDK snippet (pseudo): buf = '' for ev in stream: if ev['role']=='assistant': buf += ev['content'] buf = re.sub(r"^```+|```+$","",buf) try: parsed = json.loads(buf) except: fallback to non-streaming or retry

emily.chen: I'll send provisional quote and schedule a triage call with eng and security. Please attach minimal repro to the invite.
